rawInci: Ingredients: Aqua, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Lauramidopropyl Betaine, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Citric Acid, Sodium Chloride, Parfum, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Salicylate, Polyquaternium-10, Sodium Citrate, Tetrasodium EDTA, Hexamethylindanopyran, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Histidine, Sodium Hydroxide, Coumarin, Limonene, Vanillin, Terpineol, Glycerin, Cocos Nucifera Fruit Juice

propertyRationales.cleansingStrength: SCI, sarcosinate and two betaines form a moderate-to-upper-moderate cleansing system without a classical sulfate lead.
propertyRationales.conditioningLevel: Polyquaternium-10 provides a substantive cationic polymer route, but there are no silicones, rich lipids or strong protein films.
propertyRationales.weightPotential: One substantive cationic polymer route justifies moderate weight potential under v1.4, while the otherwise light architecture prevents a high call.
propertyRationales.focusPrimary: The formula has mildness-leaning and light conditioning signals, but without positioning they do not clearly establish a single dominant focus.
propertyRationales.focusSecondary: No secondary focus is assigned because the blind pass has no distinct manufacturer/product-positioning signal.
propertyRationales.usageRole: No reset, frequent-use or treatment trigger is present, so regular is the v1.4 default.
propertyRationales.scalpComfortTarget: The surfactant blend is comfort-leaning, but fragrance allergens and citrus peel oil mean scalp-comfort targeting remains unknown without positioning or tolerance evidence.
propertyRationales.dandruffSupport: The complete formula does not list Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole.

formulaObservations: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate are paired with Lauramidopropyl Betaine and Cocamidopropyl Betaine.
Polyquaternium-10 is the main conditioning/deposition polymer.
Tetrasodium EDTA and Sodium Citrate are present as chelator/buffer signals.
Citric Acid appears early but finished pH is unknown.
Fragrance allergens and Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil are listed.
counterSignals: Citric Acid alone is capped as weak acidic-shine evidence without finished pH.
Tetrasodium EDTA may be formula-stability support rather than a meaningful hard-water hair treatment.
Polyquaternium-10 alone does not create high conditioning or high buildup.
Fragrance and essential-oil exposure limit sensitive-scalp confidence.

finalDelta.reason: The unblind source reveals hair-moisture positioning, not cosmetic dry/tight/itchy/sensitive-scalp targeting; this resolves unknown to not_targeted.

focusPrimary.formulaRoute: Lightweight moisture is compatible with moderate cleansing plus PQ-10 light care, but does not map cleanly to volume/shine/repair/clarifying/scalp_active/gentle.
focusPrimary.decisionReason: Avoided stretching moisture/sulfate-free into gentle; final primary stays general.

usageRole.rationale: Ordinary rinse-out shampoo role; no exact non-default trigger evidence.

formulaRoutes.evidence: Polyquaternium-10 provides one cationic polymer deposition route.

competingSignals: No silicone, rich lipid, or multi-protein system; formula is positioned as lightweight.
